newsitem.title: USA: MBIA quaifies 11 muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA quaifies 11 muni issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp. on Monday said that it qualified for bond insurance the following 11 municipal bond issues, which will be sold competitively today.
--Sterling Heights, Mich., $1.04 million special assessment bonds.
--Traverse Area Pub, Mich., $15 million school building bonds.
--Montevideo Economic Development , Minn., $1.04 million housing bonds.
--North Richland Hills, Texas, $4.1 million limited tax GOs bonds.
--North Richland Hills, Texas, $2.755 million certificate of participation revenue bonds.
--Oostburg School District, Wis., $4.25 million school building GOs.
